i1.title: Surrati Honey Oud Eau de Parfum 140ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Spiced cardamom and rose melting into oud, amber and vanilla.

Surrati Honey Oud Eau de Parfum 140ml comes from Surrati's Heritage Collection. Warm cardamom opens, a floral heart of rose and jasmine follows, and it settles into a smooth base of oud, amber and vanilla.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Cardamom
  • Heart: Rose, Jasmine
  • Base: Oud, Amber, Vanilla

Key details

  • Brand: Surrati
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 140ml
  • Scent profile: Oriental · Spicy · Floral
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A warm cardamom opening
  • A rich rose and jasmine heart
  • A smooth oud, amber and vanilla base
  • Generous 140ml bottle

FAQ

What does Honey Oud smell like?

Cardamom first, then rose and jasmine, finishing with oud, amber and vanilla.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
